2608.06012.title: HERALD: Counterfactual Audits and Minimal Repairs for Proof-of-Retrieval Rewards
2608.06012.paper_summary: Search-agent rewards mix answer quality, citation grounding, tool cost, and anti-hacking terms; a high score therefore need not imply that cited evidence was retrieved, and added penalties can cancel. We introduce HERALD, an offline audit that applies exact same-question interventions, separates candidate-visible from oracle information, and enumerates detector contracts before policy optimization. On four Qwen3-8B pools from HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, $R_0$ rejects search deletion and fake IDs, but a label-free citation-laundering attack succeeds. A complete $2^3$ ablation identifies targeted strengthening of $L$---citing a corpus passage absent from the retrieved evidence---as the observed inclusion-minimal repair: $R[L]$ has zero empirical ASR with a 0.50% one-sided cluster upper bound. The gap persists across pool rules, a visible BM25 attacker, and four models; broader hardening remains vulnerable when the attack removes an oracle support-ID penalty. Under strict 5M-token matched training evaluated on 256 paired questions per benchmark, $R[L]$ meets the EM non-inferiority gate on HotpotQA and 2Wiki but not MuSiQue. Equal-suite citation precision and support recall improve by 2.02 and 1.46 points, unsupported citations fall by 1.69, and laundering attackability falls on 2Wiki and MuSiQue. Natural $L$ is not reduced, and the detector appears in only 18 of 58,368 training trajectories. HERALD thus separates robust scoring, sparse learning signal, and policy transfer.
2608.06012.paper_summary_zh: 搜尋代理的獎勵結合了答案質量、引用基礎、工具成本和防駭條款；因此，高分並不一定意味著引用的證據已被檢索，而額外的懲罰可以抵消。<lb/>我們介紹HERALD，一種離線審核，應用完全相同問題的干預，將候選可見信息與神諭信息分開，並在政策優化之前列舉檢測器合約。<lb/>在來自HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue的四個Qwen3-8B數據池中，$R_0$拒絕搜索刪除和假身份，但無標籤的引用洗錢攻擊成功。<lb/>完整的$2^3$消融實驗確定了針對性加強$L$——引用一段在檢索證據中缺失的語料段落——作為觀察到的包含最小修復：$R[L]$的實證ASR為零，且有0.50%的單側集群上限。<lb/>這一差距在池規則、可見的BM25攻擊者和四個模型之間持續存在；當攻擊移除神諭支持ID懲罰時，更廣泛的加固仍然脆弱。<lb/>在嚴格的5M標記匹配訓練下，針對每個基準的256對問題進行評估，$R[L]$在HotpotQA和2Wiki上達到EM非劣性門檻，但在MuSiQue上則未達到。<lb/>等套件的引用精度和支持召回分別提高了2.02和1.46分，無支持的引用減少了1.69，且在2Wiki和MuSiQue上的洗錢攻擊能力下降。<lb/>自然的$L$並未減少，檢測器僅出現在58,368條訓練軌跡中的18條。<lb/>因此，HERALD將穩健的評分、稀疏的學習信號和政策轉移分開。
